_doc: Bloom nests (ADR-0055): what a nest (game/data/nests/*.json) is built from. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_bloom_nest.py -> models/props/<id>[_destroyed].glb (catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_bloom_nest.py); materials game/data/materials/props_bloom_nest.json. clean is the living nest, destroyed the burned one (BloomNests swaps them when it dies). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); before the models exist each prop draws as a box of its size. Collision 'convex' = the model's own hulls (none before it exists, so the stand-in boxes never shut the heart away).

defs.name: Bloom Nest
defs.description: Pale fungal roots as thick as a man's thigh arch up out of a felted mat and close over a hollow, bracket shelves stepping up them, threads slung between. In the hollow a knot of waxy flesh pulses; at night its veins glow.

defs.name: Bloom Pods
defs.description: Sacs of translucent flesh on felt stalks, the biggest as tall as a child and splitting at the top. Something curled up moves inside.

defs.name: Overgrown Stump
defs.description: A snapped stump swallowed in felted mycelium, bracket shelves in tiers round it and pale caps at its foot.

defs.name: Remains
defs.description: Bones curled on their side, felt grown through the ribs, a canvas pack torn open beside them.
